chapters.title: Constitution and polity, year by year
chapters.intro: From the Regulating Act of 1773 to the latest amendments: every constitutional act, commission, court case and institution on the timeline, in order. It repeats the polity slides from the history chapters.

chapters.source: Constitution of India / M. Laxmikanth; NCERT (as cited on each event)

pegs.hook: 1773: the first Act of Parliament for India — the root of every later Act.
1858: Crown rule; Acts of 1861, 1892 and 1909 follow every 20–30 years.
1919: dyarchy in the provinces; 1935 moves it to the centre.
1935: the "blueprint" of the Constitution, 15 years before 1950.
1973: basic structure — Parliament cannot change the core.
1992: panchayats and municipalities in the Constitution.
